Contests.Title: For Associate Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Eight - JOHN WILEY
CITY OF ALHAMBRA SPECIAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION - MEASURE DB
Contests.MeasureText: Data Centers Prohibited. Shall an ordinance be adopted affirming the Council adopted ban on "Data Centers" by amending the Alhambra Municipal Code to again define "Data Centers" and prohibit them in all zones of the City? Supporters: Jeffrey K. Maloney; Adele Andrade-Stadler; Ross Maza; Noya Wong; Katherine Lee Opponents: None submitted.

Contests.Title: CITY OF ALHAMBRA SPECIAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION - MEASURE HT
Contests.MeasureText: Modernization/No Tax Rate Increase Measure. To maintain city services, such as: Fire protection, paramedic, 911 emergency response, crime prevention and keeping streets, infrastructure, and parks safe and well-maintained shall City of Alhambra's measure modernizing the hotel/motel transient occupancy tax be adopted at the current 12% rate for stays up to 30 days to include short-term lodging, providing an additional $134,000 annually for city services until ended by voters, with all money locally controlled? Supporters: Alhambra Firefighters Association; Alhambra Police Officers Association Opponents: None submitted.
